power.voltage: 24 VAC / 24 VDC nominal (18-32 VAC or 22-27 VDC)

features: 400 deg/sec pan preset speed, 200 deg/sec tilt preset speed
Window blanking: up to 8 four-sided user-defined zones
7 alarm inputs, 1 relay output + 1 open-collector auxiliary output
Autosensing protocol (Coaxitron, RS-422 Pelco P/D, Sensormatic, Vicon)
Auto flip rotates dome 180 degrees at bottom of tilt travel
Built-in back box memory stores camera/dome settings
Optional TXB-IP module adds IP network capability
Surface mount indoor back box, plastic construction
CE, FCC Class B, UL/cUL Listed

frigate.notes: Analog HD-over-coax camera — not a direct IP/RTSP source; ingest the RTSP output of its HDCVI/DVR instead.

home_assistant.notes: Analog camera; view via a compatible HDCVI DVR/recorder.

blue_iris.notes: Connect via a compatible HD-over-coax (HDCVI) DVR.
